title: Ex-Muslim Resources and Testimonies
intro: This page compiles the testimonies of former Muslims who have left Islam after studying its teachings, history, and practices. These individuals have dedicated themselves to sharing their journeys and helping others understand the reality they discovered. Their courage in speaking out, often at great personal risk, provides invaluable insights into the reasons why educated, sincere individuals choose to leave Islam. Below you'll find 8 verified major channels with 100K+ subscribers each, speaking in multiple languages including English, Arabic, Malayalam, Hindi, Urdu, and Tamil.
